creatives.script: Swab Summer photos can show up across several public galleries and social pages. The free CadetCatch Swab Summer photo guide puts the major sources in one place, with practical tips for keeping track of new drops. No signup is required. CadetCatch is also an independent iPhone app that shows possible photo matches for families to review themselves. It is not affiliated with USCGA, USCG, or DHS.
